docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The third volume of Bhishagratna's English Suśruta: the Uttaratantra on diseases of the eye, ear, nose and head, children's diseases and fevers, with the glossary and index (Calcutta, 1916).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: An English translation of the Sushruta samhita, based on original Sanskrit text. Edited and published by Kaviraj Kunja Lal Bhishagratna. With a full and comprehensive introd., translation of different readings, notes, comperative views, index, glossary and plates · Susruta, Bhishagratna, Kunja Lal, Kaviraj, 1865- · 1907-1916, 534 scanned pages. Published 1916 (the translator’s work of 1907–11); Kunjalal Bhishagratna died 1911; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
